content: fortune command displays random epigrams from text files. Core flags: -s (short only), -l (long only), -n <len> (set short threshold, default 160 chars), -a (all categories), -m <pattern> (grep-style filter), -i (case insensitive), -f (list files), -c (show source file), -e (equal file weighting), -w (wait after display). Data format: text files with entries delimited by % on its own line, compiled to binary .dat index by strfile. Supports multiple fortune databases and probability-weighted selection.
